Every accepted demo or AEE claim has positive evidence, required negative evidence, platform and credential posture, review state, and non-claims
WP-20 proof ownership is corrected without absorbing WP-21 or WP-21A reduction and refactoring work
The validator rejects missing paths, duplicate ownership, planned-as-passed status, synthetic proof, unsupported platform claims, and revision drift
Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding
dependencies: Legacy #5839 WP-19 validated terminal authority ancestral to the selected base
non_goals: Feature implementation or child ownership changes
Milestone quality, publication, release, or ceremony approval
